plans.title: Morning Feeder Service for Vel Tech & Morai Corridors
plans.requestText: Plan bus services for Vel Tech and Morai tomorrow morning from 7 AM to 10 AM using 4 available buses

executionSteps.reasoning: Extracted passenger check-ins and historical tap logs for the morning commuter window.
Random Forest Regressor forecasted 185 passengers taking student college hours into account.
Verified 4 active depot vehicles with clean inspection status.
Routed via Outer Ring Road connector bypassing heavy school crossing congestion.
Balanced 45-min headway ensuring buses maintain standard driver shift rest times.
Trips staggered across 2 rotations to absorb the peak without passenger crowding.

plans.adminNotes: Plan reviewed and approved for semester exam week.
